tables.name: ASimDhcpEventLogs

Since the schema represents protocol activity, it is governed by RFCs and officially assigned parameter lists. The DNS activity schema does not represent DNS server audit events.

tables.name: ASimFileEventLogs

tables.name: ASimNetworkSessionLogs

tables.name: ASimProcessEventLogs

tables.name: ASimRegistryEventLogs
tables.description: The ASim Registry Event schema represents Windows activity of creating, modifying, or deleting Windows Registry entities. Registry events are specific to Windows systems, but are reported by different systems that monitor Windows, such as EDR (End Point Detection and Response) systems, Sysmon, or Windows itself.

tables.name: ASimUserManagementActivityLogs
tables.description: The ASim User Management schema represents user management activities, such as creating a user or a group, changing user attribute, or adding a user to a group. tables.name: ASimWebSessionLogs

tables.description: Update Compliance - Update Event that combines the latest client-based data with the latest service-based data to create a complete picture for one device (client) and one update.

tables.name: UCDeviceAlert
tables.description: Update Compliance - These alerts are activated as a result of an issue that is device-specific, and is not specific to a specific update and a specific device. Like UpdateAlerts, the AlertType indicates where the Alert comes from (ServiceDeviceAlert, ClientDeviceAlert). For example, an EndOfService alert is a ClientDeviceAlert, as the fact it is on a build no longer being serviced (EOS) is a client-wide state. Meanwhile, DeviceRegistrationIssues in WUfB DS will be a ServiceDeviceAlert, as it is a device-wide state in the service to not be correctly registered.

tables.name: UCDOAggregatedStatus
tables.description: Update Compliance - aggregates all individual UCDOStatus records across the tenant and summarizes bandwidth savings across all devices enrolled to delivery.

tables.name: UCDOStatus
tables.description: Update Compliance - provides information, for a single device, on their bandwidth utilization across content types in the event they use delivery optimization.

tables.name: UCServiceUpdateStatus
tables.description: Update Compliance - Update Event that comes directly from the service-side, and only tells the "service-side" of the story, for one device (client), and one update, in one deployment. As such, this event is stripped of certain fields in favor of being able to show data in near real-time.

tables.name: UCUpdateAlert
tables.description: Update Compliance - Alert for both Client and Service Update, will contain information that needs attention, relative to one device (client), one update, and one deployment (if relevant). Certain fields may be blank depending on the UpdateAlert's AlertType field; for example, ServiceUpdateAlert will not necessarily contain client-side statuses.

tables.name: UpdateSummary

tables.name: WVDAutoscaleEvaluationPooled
tables.description: The results of an Azure Virtual Desktop Autoscale scaling plan evaluation on a hostpool. This includes information on the actions Autoscale took on the sessions hosts, such as starting or deallocating them, and why it took those actions. The column names that start with 'Config' contain the scaling plan configuration values for the current Autoscale schedule phase. If the ResultType column value is 'Failed' then join to the WVDErrors table using the CorrelationId column to get more details. For Autoscale documentation see https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2169532 .
